subject: Culture
title: The Wedding Ring Origin
description: A fast breakdown of The Wedding Ring Origin for builders.

hook.text: Ancient Egyptians placed rings on the fourth finger because they believed a vein ran from there to the heart.

buildup.text: Romans adopted the custom but saw the ring as a contract marker, not a love symbol.

discovery.text: Diamond engagement rings only became standard after De Beers ran a 1938 ad campaign inventing the tradition.

twist.text: The 'vein of love' doesn't exist. Anatomists debunked it centuries ago. The tradition survived the science.

climax.text: A ring is a loop with no end. That simple geometry carries the weight of every promise from every era.

punchline.text: The vein was a myth. The symbol still works.

quiz.question: Which company's ad campaign made diamond engagement rings standard?
